name: WeChat Vision releases WePocketModel 1.0: 2B and 4B Apache-2.0 model that generates, embeds and picks options, with GGUF builds
title: WeChat Vision releases WePocketModel 1.0: 2B and 4B Apache-2.0 model that generates, embeds and picks options, with GGUF builds
summary: One compact vision-language backbone covers image description, retrieval embeddings and candidate selection, so on-device apps need one model instead of three. The 4B leads the paper's reported comparisons across 76 benchmarks; GGUF versions are available for local use.
